name: Theme RGB
author: huacnlee
description: Keeps every device OpenRGB manages in the colours of the current Omarchy theme: keyboards, mice, RAM, fans and strips retint on theme switch and at login. Choose one theme colour or a blend of the theme colours nearest its accent from the bar.

barWidget.description: Palette glyph in the bar; click to choose one theme colour or a blend of two, three or five, previewed exactly as the LEDs will show it.
